case.name: Hashabiah

A.name: Hashabiah
A.line: Son of Bunni, father of Azrikam, ancestor of Shemaiah in Nehemiah's day

kjv.1CH 9:14: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
kjv.NEH 11:15: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

B.name: Hashabiah
B.line: son of Jeduthun (1CH 25:3), chosen twelfth by lot (1CH 25:19), descendant of Hebron (1CH 26:30)
B.notes: set apart to prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals (1CH 25:1), twelfth chosen of the singers (1CH 25:19)

kjv.1CH 25:3: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.
kjv.1CH 25:19: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
kjv.1CH 26:30: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
kjv.NEH 11:15: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

disputed_verses.BHSA NEH 11:15: וּמִֽן־הַלְוִיִּ֑ם שְׁמַעְיָ֧ה בֶן־חַשּׁ֛וּב בֶּן־עַזְרִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־חֲשַׁבְיָ֖ה בֶּן־בּוּנִּֽי׃
disputed_verses.KJV NEH 11:15: Also of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hashub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

first_reader_said: NEH 11:15: Both records are Hashabiah, son of Bunni and father of Azrikam, in Shemaiah's Levitical pedigree; A adds an unsupported tie to Jeduthun.

why: A is Hashabiah son of Bunni, father of Azrikam, in Shemaiah’s Merarite ancestry (NEH 11:15; 1CH 9:14). B’s singer is a son of Jeduthun assigned the twelfth division in David’s time (1CH 25:3,19), a different father and historical setting. NEH 11:15 belongs to A and is wrongly attached to B; B’s duplicated family ties do not establish identity. The Hebronite officer in 1CH 26:30 also has a different Levitical lineage from A’s Merarite family.
